title: Outcome tracking: post-release defect log and adopter feedback log per scheme
context: Success is measured as outcomes delivered to real beneficiaries, not tasks merged. Post-release, the project needs a maintained log tracking adoption status, post-release mapping defects, round-trip regressions, and adopter usefulness feedback per scheme. This log feeds the PLAN.md success metrics and makes the project's real-world impact (or lack thereof) visible. Without it, the project cannot know whether released schemes are working correctly in the field or being used at all.
objective: Create and maintain docs/outcomes/outcome-log.yaml — a per-scheme structured log recording adoption status, post-release critical defects (target: 0), round-trip regressions detected, and adopter usefulness feedback. Establish the log with entries for all released schemes after integration-001. Define the update cadence and ownership.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/outcomes/outcome-log.yaml created with entries for each released scheme covering: adoption status (released|adopted|deprecated), post-release critical defects count (target 0) with links to issue tracker, round-trip regressions (count and resolved/open), and adopter usefulness feedback (qualitative, from adopter check-ins)
Log schema is defined (YAML structure with required fields per scheme entry) and validated in CI or by a simple lint check
Update cadence defined (e.g., updated at each scheme release, at each adopter check-in, and at least quarterly); owner assigned (steward or maintainer)
Log is linked from PLAN.md success metrics section and README.md
Log initialized with at least one entry (the first adopted scheme from integration-001) after that task completes
resources: PLAN.md — Success metrics (outcome metrics table); Sustainability (outcome tracking)
output: docs/outcomes/outcome-log.yaml (with schema definition and initial entry); update cadence and ownership documented in docs/outcomes/README.md
